desc: Ideation of algorithm (component-wise XOR minimization via independent per-bit root choice).
Implement iterative BFS/DFS solution: build labeled graph, detect self-loop contradictions (Z_i != 0 on X_i==Y_i), assign relative XOR D[v] per component, detect inconsistent cycles returning -1.
Per-component, per-bit root choice: set root bit b to 1 iff it strictly lowers the number of ones (count > size - count).
Reconstruct each node's value A[v] = D[v] XOR R_component and print space-separated.
Edge cases covered: M=0 (all zeros), disconnected components, conflicting duplicate edges, self-loops, large Z within bit range.
